stem:
Serena and Ricky each have a milkshake. The two milkshakes are the same size.

• Serena drinks \( \frac{5}{6} \) of her milkshake.

• Ricky drinks \( \frac{5}{8} \) of his milkshake.

Compare the amounts that Serena and Ricky drink.
instruction: Choose the correct answer from each drop-down menu to complete the sentence.
difficulty_rationale: Requires comparing fractions with unlike denominators to determine which fraction is greater, then interpreting that result in context to make a comparison statement.
